_comment: mcp-run server registry. Secret-bearing MCP servers launch through ~/.local/bin/mcp-run. To add a server: add an entry here, then reference it from Zed (context_servers) and agy (~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json) with { "command": "/home/erikzen/.local/bin/mcp-run", "args": ["<name>"] }.

AUTH_HEADER._comment: Bitwarden item holding the Balcon Padel MCP bearer token. Adjust 'item' to match your vault entry; 'field' defaults to 'password'.
